overview.text: Laso combines crypto-funded consumer cards, gift cards and transfers with an agent payment API and managed-wallet platform. Its agent page advertises cards, debit-card and contractor payouts, bank rails and payments to other x402 endpoints. Availability is country- and product-dependent; user and volume counters and a FinCEN registration claim do not independently establish eligibility, approval, insurance or safety. Documentation lists x402 USDC on Base and Solana and MPP on Base only. The fee-inclusive challenge total can exceed the requested face amount. x402 settles after route success, while MPP may settle first, leaving paid USDC in the Laso account balance after a later route error for withdrawal or retry rather than an automatic refund. The signing wallet identifies the account receiving credentials. No-account and zero-fee marketing is qualified by account authentication, managed-wallet setup, on-chain monitoring, conversion, deposit fees and possible issuer exchange fees. Current x402 v2 documentation rejects legacy v1 envelopes shown in an older homepage illustration.
